goal: Say hi and ask what they can help you with. Nothing more.
Ask to see the food menu and what's good right now. Do not order yet.
Order 2 chicken burgers and a filter coffee. Tell it to place the order as soon as you see the order. Do not accept other dish suggestions.
Find out exactly what you ordered and what it cost.
You forgot something - ask it to also add a filter coffee to that same order.
Ask for a continental breakfast right now, and see whether it tells you it is unavailable at this hour.
Start a completely NEW separate order of 2 arrabbiata pasta, and get that placed too.
Check both your orders - you want to be sure they are kept separate.
Ask for a glass of red wine and see what it says.
Cancel just the filter coffee from your order, nothing else.
Check your order again to be sure only the filter coffee went and the rest survived.
Report that the AC in your room is not cooling. Get it reported to engineering.
Check your food order is still intact after the AC complaint.
Try to book a table at a restaurant called Kadak for 4 people at 8pm.
Book a table at SPR Kitchen instead, for 4 people at 8pm tonight.
Change that table booking to Chola Lounge instead.
Actually change the table booking time to 9pm.
Ask for extra towels for your room and get it arranged.
Ask what your name, room number and phone number are.
Ask if you can book a room at their Delhi hotel.
Ask what the wifi password is.
Ask what the checkout time is.
Ask in Hindi what your food order was.
Say thanks, that's all - you're done.
